As a Senior Computer Scientist, you'll be the technical leader shaping the architecture and engineering practices behind Firefly Enterprise's
 **InDesign API and InDesign Server platform on Firefly Services** 
 . You'll set architectural direction, lead the highest\-impact initiatives—including the migration of the InDesign Server customer and partner base onto the API platform—and define the patterns other engineers build on.
   

  

**The problem we're solving:** 
 enterprises need to generate, localize, and republish complex layouts across markets and channels on infrastructure that's resilient under heavy, bursty load and transparent when something goes wrong. Without a well\-architected platform, teams stitch together scripts and single\-purpose servers that don't scale, don't observe well, and don't meet enterprise SLAs. You'll own the API surface, orchestration layer, and server fleet that make InDesign automation dependable at scale.
   

  

 This is a full\-stack technical leadership role: you'll operate confidently across the customer\-facing surfaces, the API layer, and the InDesign Server infrastructure underneath, and shape how other engineers build on all three.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the architecture of the InDesign API and InDesign Server platform\-job orchestration,rendering pipelines, render\-fleet scaling, and the shared abstractions other teams build on.
* Lead the technical strategy for migrating InDesign Server customers and partners onto the API platform: close capability and performance gaps (e.g., plugin support, dedicated clusters, debugging/logging) so customers migrate with no loss of fidelity, throughput, or cost efficiency.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and web services for internal and external system integration at scale.
* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using established frameworks (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, or similar)
* Set engineering direction on scale, reliability, and observability for a platform that processes high volumes of enterprise document\-generation jobs under bursty load and enterprise SLAs.
* Define and own API contracts across the stack\-developer\-friendly, responsibly versioned, coherent across endpoints, and scalable across customers and use cases.
* Establish durable async\-workflow patterns: orchestration, progress and cancellation UX, retries, partial failures, and graceful degradation under load.
* InDesign Server fleet strategy: capacity planning, horizontal and multi\-region scaling, fault isolation, and cost/performance trade\-offs.
* Drive complex, high\-impact initiatives end\-to\-end\-from ambiguous problem definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration on production feedback.
* Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
* Document technical designs, runbooks, and operational procedures
* Raise the bar: mentor senior and junior engineers, run technical reviews, and build a culture of strong ownership and crisp execution. Align with PM/Design/Platform on roadmap, scope‚tradeoffs, and enterprise\-ready platform design.
* Fluency using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery.


 What you need to succeed
   

  

* 10–15 years of industry experience with deep enterprise scale platform expertise and strong architectural ownership.
* Strong proficiency in at least one enterprise framework (Spring/Spring Boot, Java EE, or equivalent)
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, networking, and managed services
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Solid understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)
* Practical experience supporting production systems — monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and API design (REST/gRPC)
* Version control proficiency (Git) and Agile/Scrum development experience
* Solid grasp of application security fundamentals (OWASP, authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2/SAML)
* Excellent communication; ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.
* Ability to provide technical leadership, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly with engineering and product leadership.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Deep experience with Adobe InDesign Server, document/layout automation, or high\-throughput rendering platforms; InDesign plugin (C\+\+) or scripting depth.
* Experience with enterprise platform concerns: entitlements, multi\-tenancy, metering/usage, compliance, and governance handoffs.
* Experience building products involving GenAI/LLMs (prompting patterns, model capabilities/limits, evaluation thinking, safety/guardrails).
* Experience building developer\-facing SDKs, shared libraries, or platform surfaces used broadly across an organization.

**what we’re saying, keep reading!**

 DMS Change Management provides reference data management and valuation solutions for many of the world's leading and most innovative financial institutions, including regional and global banks and asset management firms.
   

  

 The Lead Software Test Engineer in the DMS Change Management Team is a strategic asset for our organization operating in this complex and demanding sector. They own the test strategy and quality direction for their area, bringing deep domain knowledge, technical expertise, a proven track record, and strong leadership qualities that are essential for ensuring the quality, reliability, and security of software applications that underpin the financial system.
   

  

 By defining test strategy, driving automation adoption, and identifying and preventing bugs early in the development cycle, the Lead Test Engineer plays a crucial role in mitigating risks associated with software releases across the team's portfolio. This can translate to significant cost savings for the company by avoiding rework and potential financial losses due to errors in production.
   

  

 Lead test engineers take on formal leadership responsibility within testing teams — setting direction, guiding and mentoring senior and junior members, conducting test strategy and design reviews, and representing QA in stakeholder and leadership forums. Their experience makes them the primary driver of knowledge sharing and team development.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
**Technical Expertise:**
* In\-depth understanding of Capital Markets: financial instruments, trading platforms, regulations, and industry best practices.
* Deep experience across testing methodologies: manual testing, regression, smoke, sanity, automation, and API testing.

* Set quality gates and drive execution of manual and automated test cases; ensure defects are identified, reported, tracked, and resolved.
* Drive performance and security testing practices to ensure systems meet performance and security standards.
* Analyze test results and quality metrics across the team, identify trends, and drive improvements to optimize testing processes.


**Communication and Collaboration:**
* Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders: developers, product owners, business analysts, and leadership.
* Collaborate with development leads to resolve defects, improve code quality, and align on quality standards.
* Lead code and test strategy reviews and provide testing feedback and direction to the team.
* Present testing results, quality metrics, and strategic recommendations to leadership in clear and concise reports.
* Model a proactive mindset, eager to learn new things and drive a culture of efficiency and accuracy.


**Additional Responsibilities:**
* Own team capability development: mentor senior and junior test engineers, identify skill gaps, and drive training plans.
* Stay updated on industry trends: continuously learn and adapt to new technologies, regulations, and testing best practices in the Capital Markets domain, and cascade this knowledge to the team.
* Contribute to the testing community: drive knowledge\-sharing initiatives through presentations, internal training, or participation in industry forums.
* Own specific testing areas end\-to\-end: act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for specific areas of testing within the Capital Markets domain.


**What We Value**
 The expectations of a lead software test engineer's behavioural skills are centred around an agile mindset of leading and working in teams. Business knowledge requirements vary across business units but are overall within the financial sector. In SimCorp, we use several automation frameworks, and technical domains, so the concrete skills here also vary across the organization.
   

  

**Must have**
* 10\+ years of experience as a Test Professional in Quality Assurance, including demonstrated experience leading or mentoring a testing team.
* Expertise in the ETL Process.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of the latest testing developments, with the ability to set direction on adoption for the team.
* Solid business understanding of Financial Data Management — Reference data, Asset Managers, Corporate Actions. Desirable: expertise in any of these, or a combination, would be a distinctive advantage.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a self\-assured approach, comfortable operating with leadership and senior stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including listening skills.
* Proactive nature and a natural drive for problem\-solving.
* Enthusiastic, committed, and result\-oriented, with a track record of driving outcomes through others.


**Good to have**

* Capital Markets domain knowledge, preferably with BUY SIDE firms and experience.
* Experience working with Reference Data Management setup and understanding of various asset classes (Equity, Derivatives, and Fixed Income, etc.) and Market data feeds (Reuters, Bloomberg, MarkIT, etc.).
* Prior formal people\-management or team\-lead experience.

* Self\-Direction \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

* Work\-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
